items.q: Before any invasive bedside procedure, what is the non negotiable opening?

Start quickly and explain afterwards
Use any available unsterile kit if rushed
Skip identity checks for familiar patients
items.exp: Identity, consent, allergy and site checks prevent wrong patient and wrong site catastrophe. Sterile preparation and help complete readiness (NMC CBME, India; GMC guidance, UK).

Filling bottles in any order without checking

items.q: Peripheral cannulation fails twice in a sick patient needing urgent access. What is the OSCE correct escalation?
o: Call for senior help, consider alternative sites or intraosseous access per protocol and keep reassessing the patient
Keep trying the same vein indefinitely
Abandon access and all treatment
Use an unsterile improvised device
items.exp: Repeated failure demands escalation, not fixation. Senior help and protocol alternatives, including intraosseous access in extremis, protect the patient (Resuscitation Council UK principles).

items.q: What makes oxygen prescribing a procedure, not a background detail?
o: Target saturation range, device and flow are prescribed, monitored and reviewed like a medicine
Oxygen needs no prescription anywhere
More oxygen is always safer
Targets matter only in intensive care

items.q: In a breaking bad news OSCE, what structure protects the patient?
o: Warning shot, plain language, silence for reaction, empathy and a checked summary with follow up
Giving every detail in one rapid monologue
Starting with false reassurance
Ending without any next step
items.exp: Paced, honest communication lets the patient absorb and decide. Checking understanding and fixing follow up complete the duty (GMC guidance, UK).
r: News without a plan abandons the patient.

items.q: When a patient declines a recommended procedure in an OSCE, the correct move is which?
o: Explore understanding and concerns, give balanced information, respect capacity based refusal and document with safety netting
Proceed because the doctor knows best
Threaten discharge for non compliance
Stop all other care in protest
items.exp: Capacity based refusal is a right. Exploration often reveals fixable fears, and documentation with alternatives and return advice respects autonomy safely (GMC consent guidance, UK).
